 and Registrar's  order with  Signatures  WPCRL No. 1021 of 2024  Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.
Mr. B.S. Koranga, Advocate for the petitioner.
2. Mr. Saurabh Pandey, Brief Holder for the State of Uttarakhand.

3. Petitioner has registered FIR for offence punishable under Section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act and Sections 354, 377, 452, 498A, 504 and 506 IPC, registered at Police Station Bazpur, District Udham Singh Nagar on 09.10.2023.
4.
In this writ petition, petitioner has alleged that police is not taking any interest in the matter and the investigation has not been completed so far.

5. Learned counsel for petitioner submits that petitioner has reasonable apprehension that the Investigating Officer is under some kind of pressure, due to which, he is not discharging his duties in a free and fair manner.
6. Learned State Counsel, however, disputes the said submission.

7. Having regard to the averments made in the writ petition, the writ petition is disposed of by directing the Investigating Officer to conclude investigation in respect of the aforesaid FIR, as early as possible, but not later than two months from the date production of certified copy of this order.
